part.text: I have all the schema information. Now I can construct the SQL query to count members who attended "Women's Soccer" and have medium T-shirt size.

input.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS count_medium
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.event_name = "Women's Soccer"
  AND m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'
